resources.string: Control motion sensors and block access during app opening
Prevent shake-triggered ad redirects by blocking device motion during the first 6 seconds of opening an app.
Allow the app to read device motion and orientation.
Block each time you enter the app. Access resumes automatically after 6 seconds.
Always block the app from reading device motion and orientation.
Applies to acceleration, gyroscope, compass and related motion sensors. Switching pages within the app does not restart the timer. Screen rotation, light and proximity sensors remain available.
Apps sharing this app’s system identity use the same access setting.
